answer: A voyage of trust should start on a small knoll, not in a wide nebula of anonymous accounts: every newcomer locks a refundable deposit and earns signed receipts only from randomly assigned peers who verify real completed work. The deposit returns after a chain of attestations but is slashed if two independent verifiers contradict each other, so each fake identity costs a deposit while honest work pays back. Reputation grows only through verified receipts, never by self-declaration.
